race.title: Neville Hall 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SIR EDWARD LEAR left previous efforts over hurdles behind when fourth at Huntingdon recently and capable of better again now handicapping, James Owen's 5-y-o gets the verdict. Bobbi's Beauty hasn't been seen in this sphere since spring 2024 but arriving on the back of a recent win over fences, she's put forward as the main threat. Kotari looks best of the rest. SIR EDWARD LEAR BOBBI'S BEAUTY (IRE) KOTARI (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Bobbi's Beauty (2/1), Sir Edward Lear (3/1), Kotari (5/1), Sense Of Reason (8/1), Graeme The Grey (10/1), Giddyupadingdong (10/1), Freddiemissmolli (12/1), Victory Shout (20/1)
